text: player
6. The Final Chapter Begins
(Three days ago...)
Jane
Well... No bugs detected, and the privacy film's all set on the windows...
Looking good. Now I can finally clear my head and think.
But Jane... why did we have to come all the way to my place to do this?
Well, I just couldn't leave my precious assistant all alone, could I?
Honestly, it's just a tactical precaution. My detective's intuition never lies!
I've already set up security at my place, but I realized there was one more vital location that needed protection.
So that's why you're here...
Relax! You've been acting like you're on edge ever since I walked in.
Hohoho... It's fine. Anyone would be starstruck by a sudden visit from a genius detective like me.
Actually, Jane, you've been standing there with crossed arms and a tapping foot the whole time.
If I remember your body language lessons correctly, that means you're the one who's on edge...
Huh? Me? You think?
Oh... well, yeah! I mean, sure! That must be it!
I-I was just thinking... You've done a great job with your counter-surveillance! Very impressive! Honestly!
Glad you noticed.
Just the basics, really...
Ahem! Anyway, back to the case.
"When the arms of the giant fall and meet, twilight's final chapter will be complete..." That's what "D" wrote.
So... what's your deduction, Jane?
This message is a total invitation to a showdown. It's got the time and the place written all over it.
...And "the arms of the giant" must be the giant clock tower in One Han City from that same story!
Look, the giant hour and minute hands... don't they look exactly like a giant's arms?
So "fall and meet" would mean...
Combined with the "twilight"...
I'd guess somewhere around... 6:32 PM!
Bingo! But technically, it's 6:30 sharp.
Hmm? Why's that?
The clock in One Han City has a special design. The hour hand doesn't drift. It just clicks forward one notch every hour.
That means the hour hand stays at 6, while the minute hand points straight down to the 6 at the same time.

And the date is when "twilight's final chapter will be complete," which is the release day of the weekly magazine that serialized The Adventures of Jane Christie... meaning Monday, three days from now!
Well... the time and place for our showdown are set. Let's get moving.
So we're basically walking into the enemy's home turf.
That's right! But hey, with you here, I'm not afraid of anything!
Wait – let's double-check our gear. Rope, gloves... everything we might need for a clock tower.
Peanut
*squeak*!
Back in the present. Inside the clock tower.
For someone who's "not afraid"...
...you've been clutching my sleeve like a lifeline, Jane.
I-I-I mean, I have to! It's a precaution!
Ugh... What a jerk! Did that "D" seriously plan around my fear of heights?!
Assistant! You are NOT to leave my side! Understood?!
Of course, Detective!
Well, you'd better keep up then.
Well... if my deduction is right, "D" is waiting for us at the top.
Honestly, I knew this guy was obsessed, but this is a bit much.
Ugh... I've got a bad feeling about this...
Jane...? Are you okay?
Is something wrong?
No, it's... nothing. I'm just thinking about some of the dark twists in the novel...
Let's keep going – whoa?!!
A mechanical noise clunks, and suddenly the floor drops out. Before any of us can react –
The stable platform splits in two. Walking one after the other, the two of us are separated onto different levels.
Now, driven by the mechanism, the two platforms move until they are stacked directly on top of each other.
Jane peeks over the edge of the top platform, looking down at me.
{var:player_nickname}! Are you okay?!
I'm okay, but... what just happened?!
Kehehe! The "genius" detective and her trusty assistant, right in my trap –
What fate awaits them? Will they be separated by death like in the novel, or will they perish together? Let's find out!
Jane, we meet at last.
I know that tone... You're... "D"!
Sharp as always, but not sharp enough. You still walked right into my trap.
What's that supposed to mean?
Guess your assistant isn't a fan of your grandma's work, Jane. Kehehe... this is the classic scene from The Adventures of Jane Christie!
The Bridge of Death...
Bingo! My genius mechanism has perfectly recreated the scene!
These two platforms will slowly close in until your assistant down there is crushed flat –
Unless you solve my puzzles and enter the right codes, of course...
Every detail is spot on! Seeing your grandma's story in real life must be a dream, Jane.
This isn't a game! {var:player_nickname}! Get ready to get down!
You might have to lie flat! Just stay as low as you can! Like a pancake!
I-I got it!
Are you kidding me?!
Is this how it ends...
Kehehe... Have fun with that, Detective!
Dammit! Get back here! Hey...!
This thing is actually moving?!
She's not playing around! But don't worry, I can solve this!
This should be the passcode screen... Why does it look so familiar... Wait, is this a 1:1 replica of Christie's phone?! Those are expensive!
Not the time, Jane!
Okay! Let's do this! First, a mahjong scoring question? Interesting. If the dealer wins with Menzen Tsumo, Pinfu, and Pure Straight... 20 Fu, 4 Han... that's 2,600 points each!
It's still moving?!
I-I've got this! This is nothing for a genius like me!
"BOCK HIDE...?" Forget the words... look at the letters! They're all horizontally symmetrical, so the answer is the missing "X"!
Jane quickly solves each puzzle, and the mechanism clicks each time she enters an answer.
The top platform is getting closer. I have to crouch as the space gets smaller and smaller.
How are we doing, Jane?!
The answer is... 1666! Okay! Just one more!
Huh...?
Before she can solve the last one, Jane suddenly stops, but the platform doesn't. The space is almost gone, and the gears make a terrible grinding sound as dust falls on my face.
Jane!? What's wrong?!
I-I'm okay! It's just a little harder than I thought, I...
Hurry, Jane! It's right on top of me!
I've got it!! This is the code!
With a heavy rumble, the platform halts its descent and slowly begins to rise. I can finally stand up again.
Jane jumps down and hugs me tight before the platform even fully stops.
Are you okay?! Did she put any traps in there?! You're not hurt, are you?
No, I'm good.
Thanks to you.
That's good... Whew... I thought...
Jane... What happened to you back there?
Oh, it's... nothing!
I was just... a little frustrated by that last puzzle. Anyway, where's Peanut?
*squeak*!
Peanut! There you are! I'm glad you're okay.
Come on, Assistant, let's go get her!
Just don't push it, Jane.
I'm fine! But... just to be safe, maybe you should hold my hand?
You mean... like this?
Yeah! Now we can't be split up no matter what!
As evening falls, the sky turns an ominous crimson, and Jane and I continue climbing the stairs inside the clock tower.
After what just happened, we're sticking even closer together. She's holding my hand tightly as we make our way up.
She's being more cautious than usual... but her palm is sweating, and her grip keeps tightening.
As we reach the next floor and step into a new room...
Hmm? Where are we...
Bang!
Jane, the door just slammed shut!
Something's wrong... Wait!
"D"... She's recreated this too...?!
Doors and windows sealed, no keyhole. No patterns on the walls either.
"No tools to use, and no path forward..."
It's just like the novel... The wallpaper is a rusty color, and there are Möbius strips all over the ceiling...
I'm afraid we're trapped in a locked room we can never escape.
Never? What makes you say that?
If I'm right, this is another one of her elaborate mechanisms...
After the Bridge of Death comes the Room of Despair...
*clack*
Before Jane can finish, a mechanical sound echoes, and white mist begins to fill the room as the temperature drops.
*cough*... Is it just me, or is it getting cold in here?
Oh no...! Don't breathe the air!
In the original story, Christie was trapped in a room just like this! It's going to fill with a deadly, freezing gas! What happens next... is too horrible to even imagine...
In this "perfectly locked room," not even Christie could find a way out...
Now that you mention it, it is starting to feel a bit stuffy...
But this is real life, not a story, isn't it?
Don't worry about the rumors.
But...
But in the original story...
...Christie's assistant died on the Bridge of Death!
The final code for the platform... it was "Death." That's why... I couldn't...
I was so worried that if I got it right, I'd lose you...
You've always been there for me, but I keep putting your life on the line...
All the things I want to do... the justice I want to serve... is it really worth it?
Am I really... fit to be a detective?
(Hug her)
You've done a great job, Jane.
{var:player_nickname}...?
Whatever happens, Jane, none of this is your fault.
You're fighting for what you believe in, for your own pride, and you never give up, even against overwhelming odds...
I'm here because I want to be, Jane. No matter what happens, I'm with you.
{var:player_nickname}... *sob* Thank you.
Besides...
I don't think this is how our story ends.
Huh...?
The story says the assistant died. But look at me, I'm still here.
We've rewritten the ending. So now, our future is whatever we make it.
And I'm sure if anyone can find the truth, it's you, Jane.
"Every action has a consequence, and every consequence leaves a trail."
I believe in you, Jane.
Assistant...
Hmm, you're right! I've got this! Time for the genius detective to shine!
Hehe... being held like this, it's not so cold in here anymore...
Wait... how is it "cold"?
What is it?
Peanut! Get up there and see what you can find!
*squeak*!
Hohoho... I see it now! "D" is in for a surprise! Assistant! Give me a lift, would you?
With pleasure!
It's almost time. That detective and her little sidekick must have passed out by now. Time for some photos for the papers!
Outside on the rooftop
Kehehe... Some detectives they are. No one can beat Christie but me!
Don't be so sure!
What?!!!
"D"! It's all over. Surrender now!
No way! I broke you! Your deductions, your pride... I should have crushed them all!
Hohoho! You see, in the story, Christie fell into despair because she was alone...
But I'm not! My assistant is right here with me!
When we survived the Bridge of Death, our story changed right then and there!
That annoying little assistant...! But how did you find the way out?
"Every action has a consequence, and every consequence leaves a trail." Remember?
That's Christie's own line... So what?!
It means... everything you do leaves a trace, no matter how smart you think you are!
Your "perfect" setup was too good to be true. That's exactly how we knew.
And my assistant saw through those Möbius stickers on the ceiling!
Your game is up! You lost, "D"!
Kehehe... Hahaha! And here I thought I just needed to take care of Christie. Can't believe I got outplayed by an assistant...
But it's not over yet! I've had a hang glider ready for this exact moment! You'll never...
Wait, the rope's broken?!
*squeak*!
That stupid ferret? Dammit!
Now! Assistant! Throw the gas bomb at her!
Gas bomb?!!!
On it...!
(Throw it hard)
"D" dodges in a panic, and the "bomb" falls behind her.
Nice try – but you missed!
Kehehe... You thought an untrained amateur could hit me? Whoa?!!
*CLANG*!!
At that exact second, the hour hand clicks forward, its tip snagging "D" by the clothes and lifting her into the air.
It was all part of Jane's plan.
There! That "deadly gas" was just some dry ice.
Since CO2 from dry ice is heavier than air, it sinks and collects near the bottom – and in high enough concentrations, it's dangerous to anyone, even the person who set the trap.
So the exit had to be up high!
Oh... that's why it was so cold.
Exactly, and the exit was hidden by those Möbius stickers... Hohoho, thanks to your sharp eyes, Assistant!
Let's head to the roof after we catch our breath... Oh, and bring some of that dry ice.
How about this piece?
Good. Just be careful not to get frostbite. Use those gloves of yours.
You want me to... use this to attack her?
Hohoho... I've got something better in mind.
Remember what I said about the clock hands of the One Han City clock tower? They click forward each hour, and that mechanical force should be enough.
I'll distract her while you throw the dry ice to force her into the right spot... Can you make the shot?
Maybe... but I'll try!
No problem!
Hohoho! I believe in us, Assistant. That's why we're a great team!
We're going to take "D" down together. Ready? Let's do it!
A few days later.
Ahem! I'm happy to announce the Detective X Agency is officially back for business!
Let's get started.
Hurray!
And I've picked your place as our new base! You're welcome!
Well, I guess I'll need to do some redecorating.
Oh, and I've got an update on "D."
Between the theft, trespassing, vandalism and attempted assault, the combined sentence should keep her behind bars for years.
Justice is served, then.
Exactly. But we're not finished yet. There's always another case to solve!
Ready to make some history, Assistant?
You bet.
Ready when you are, Detective!
Before long, tales of a brilliant detective and her reliable assistant were the talk of One Han City.
With their seamless chemistry and unbreakable bond, no case was too tough for them to crack.
And so, their detective adventures continue, one case at a time.
Kehehe... Have fun with that, Detective!
This thing is actually moving?!
She's not playing around! But don't worry, I can solve this!
I've got this...! Almost there! Ugh...!
It's coming down! Jane!
J-just stay calm! Get down... no! Lie flat! I'm almost there!
I do as she says and hope for the best... Finally, the platform stops, and everything goes back to normal.
Assistant! Are you okay? Talk to me!
I'm fine. But seeing you stuck on a puzzle? That's a first.
Th-that's only because... I was so worried about you that I panicked, okay?!
Ugh... I suppose my composure as a detective still needs some serious work...
No! No time for that. We have to catch her!
But we were too late. By the time we reached the roof, "D" was already gone.
The detective agency was suffering too. We both knew "D" was behind this.
Then one day, Jane received an anonymous letter. It just said "You lost, Detective."
I think this is a clue! Let's go, Assistant! We're not done with her yet!
This time, I'm going to make her pay! Just you wait!
Jane and I continue our investigation through One Han City. Something tells me this case is just getting started...
After all, if they managed to steal my grandma's manuscript, they've got to know a thing or two about snooping around.
Like Grandma always said, "Every action has a consequence, and every consequence leaves a trail." The truth is always out there – you just have to look for it.
It's a bit cryptic, but "D" is clearly obsessed with Grandma's work. If we search her books for these lines... the truth will reveal itself!
So... the "final chapter" has to be the very last part of The Adventures of Jane Christie.
Just you wait, "D"! I'm taking back my pride and my grandma's manuscript!
Everything about this tower... It's like a page-for-page recreation of Grandma's novel.
D
Everything in this tower, and the trap we just escaped from... they're all straight out of Grandma's book.
Since the story ended there, the mystery of the Room of Despair was never solved. Some say Grandma couldn't think of a way out, so she...
Hohoho... When do both hands overlap and point straight down?
That voice... she sounds so young?!
We went home disappointed, but then all sorts of rumors about Jane started showing up in the papers at One Han City... from "violent" arrests to failing her exams, and even rumors about us dating.
